source_review_lint.detail: NO PREFIX/GLOB/BASENAME/DIRECTORY-WIDE LEGACY EXEMPTION. validate_legacy matches on the whole triple (wrapper_module, from, to) through an exact dict lookup index_by_key[(wrapper, edge['from'], edge['to'])]; there is no startswith, no fnmatch, no glob and no directory test anywhere in the exemption path, and the module imports neither re nor fnmatch nor glob. An edge matching zero rows is 'unlisted Legacy edge ... at file:line'; an edge matching more than one row is rejected; a row matching no live edge is 'stale'. is_legacy_module tests membership of the exact namespace plus a separator, so LegacyWrappers, the bare Legacy namespace and a deeper Foo.Legacy.Bar get nothing, and _legacy_row_failures additionally rejects a wrapper_module that is not under that namespace. In main, Legacy edges are lifted out of the forbidden set before waivers are considered, but every one of them must still be matched by an exact manifest row through validate_legacy, so the lift is not a loophole; --fail-on-legacy rejects every Legacy edge, listed or not. WAIVER AUTHENTICATION UNCHANGED: validate_waivers still authenticates against the frozen graph mapping from load_frozen_edges (waiver honoured only when the FROZEN record classes the pair forbidden and the edge is still live, with .summary counts recomputed); the only diff inside it is one added optional parameter retired_by_legacy and a more informative stale message that names the retiring wrapper. load_frozen_edges gained strictly additive validation (schema, 8-hex base_head, empty-field and duplicate-(from,to,line) rejection, exit 2), which strengthens the basis and does not weaken it; it still passes on the untouched frozen file. LIVE RECORD NEVER AUTHENTICATES: the only code paths referring to the dated record are live_record_document/write_live_record (generator mode, --write-record, which returns immediately) plus documentation; the file is never opened for reading, and a test asserts that pointing --graph at a live record exits 2 because it carries no base_head. DIRECTORY RULE IS CLASSIFICATION ONLY: CLUSTER_DIR_COMPONENTS is consulted solely inside cluster_of, on whole dotted components (module.split('.'), leftmost match wins), and cluster_of only decides ownership; it never permits an edge.

source_review_registry.detail: NO REGEX: the file imports no re/regex/fnmatch module; the only occurrences of the letters 're.' are prose. Parsing is str.split / rfind / isdigit / startswith only. FOUR DIRECT-CALL CHAIN CHECKS: FACTORIZATION_CHAIN is exactly ((legacy_wrapper, coordinator), (coordinator, producer), (coordinator, eliminator), (eliminator, open_leaf)), each verified by _calls_directly(caller in backend.callers(callee)) against the kernel-mined call graph; a transitive row replaces exactly one of those pairs by an explicit path that is then verified hop by hop, and a transitive row naming a non-chain pair is rejected. CYCLE CHECK: the callers relation restricted to the five role symbols is materialised and find_role_cycle reports any cycle by role and symbol. DIGEST NORMALIZATION: normalize_statement is ' '.join(text.split()) (every whitespace run collapsed to one space, ends stripped), digested with sha256 and compared against the pinned open_leaf and legacy_wrapper digests; a non-64-hex pin, a missing pin or an unknown pinned key is itself a violation. ALIAS MIGRATION RULES: a rename is planned only for a v2 block whose open_leaf differs from the ledger symbol; it is REJECTED when legacy_wrapper is not the previous name (recorded as 'would allocate a new id'), when the new leaf is already assigned to another id, when the new leaf is already an alias of another id, when the old name is already an alias of another id, when the old name does not resolve to exactly one index record, and when that record is private. apply_alias_migrations moves the id to the new symbol, records the old name in aliases with renamed_from/renamed_at_head, and explicitly does NOT retire or reissue the id. PER-DECLARATION FRESHNESS IS REAL, NOT SIMULATED: see freshness_method. PRODUCER CLEANLINESS IS THE AXIOM CLOSURE, NOT has_sorry: check_v2_block calls backend.axioms(symbol) (proof-blueprint axioms, i.e. the transitive #print axioms closure) for producer, coordinator and eliminator; the producer fails on sorryAx, Lean.ofReduceBool, Lean.trustCompiler or ANY axiom whose tag is not 'core'; coordinator and eliminator may carry sorryAx (they consume the open leaf) but nothing else non-core. has_sorry is used only for the separate open-leaf identity check (the leaf must carry a sorry), never as the producer trust test, and a dedicated test proves a producer whose own has_sorry is False still fails when a helper contributes sorryAx transitively.

freshness_method.method: Per-symbol mined freshness has no CLI surface, so BlueprintBackend reads the blueprint database READ-ONLY: sqlite3.connect(path.as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True) on the path named by [paths] db in .blueprint.toml. mined_build(symbol) = symbol_mined.file_hash for that symbol, or None when no row exists (never mined). current_build() parses 'current build: <short id>' from `proof-blueprint refs --check` and expands it to the unique full fingerprint carrying that prefix across symbol_mined.file_hash and module_mined.global_fp; zero or several matches raise RegistryError and become a 'cannot verify' violation, never 'fresh'. A role (and every declared transitive hop) is fresh only when mined_build == current_build.
freshness_method.independently_verified: The checker confirmed .blueprint.toml has db = 'data/proof-blueprint.db'; that symbol_mined(symbol TEXT PRIMARY KEY, file_hash TEXT NOT NULL, mined_at TEXT NOT NULL) and module_mined(module_name, olean_hash, global_fp, mined_at, ...) exist with those columns; that `proof-blueprint refs --check` prints 'current build: f80c3204eef5'; and that the prefix f80c3204eef5 expands to exactly one distinct value in each table (COUNT(DISTINCT ...) = 1 in both), namely f80c3204eef5b7d2ca4586d17e7a4f19e3d17075d5041e608907d2c440fe72e2. The read is read-only (mode=ro URI) and the database file was not modified.
freshness_method.caveat: Symbols inside the .blueprint.toml [mining] skip set can only ever read stale or never-mined under this rule. The rule is fail-closed, so that direction is safe.
